description: Wire the Vignette visual mode into packages/captions/tools/render-full.ts (default for the improved v2 output), run the full v2 render, and enforce every acceptance gate. Extend render-full.ts to: run runVignette(sheet, lib, { phrases: storyboard.script.phrases }); block on validation/staging/camera/coverage failure; reject unknown/unresolved assets and non-S7 placeholders; pass solved shots to the new vignette-full-page adapter; run a 30fps dense camera audit before encode; run the teacher/door pixel-geometry gates and the performance-motion gates via the adapter diagnostics; keep caption face-safety, production profile, Chromium playback, AAC round-trip, and MP4 audio alignment; preserve the exact approved VO bytes/timing and VO+event-SFX-only audio (no music). Produce the complete packages/captions/full-render-v2/ output set. Preserve v1 untouched. Depends on FEAT-002 (adapter) and FEAT-001 (ffmpeg/Chromium/voice).
steps: Add a visual-mode switch to render-full.ts. Options: keep the legacy stills-page path available behind e.g. --visual narrated, and add --visual vignette as the DEFAULT when producing the v2 output. Add an --out that defaults to packages/captions/full-render-v2 for vignette mode, and an mp4 name zapp-vs-kira-competitor-performance-v2.mp4. NEVER write into packages/captions/full-render/ (v1). Keep --voice and --ffmpeg required; export/use FFPROBE_PATH so probeFile uses real ffprobe.

In vignette mode, after authenticating the approved MP3 (unchanged: checkContainer + SHA-256 == sb.audio.contentHash, decode to 48k mono, decodedDuration within tolerance, pad voice to N frames never cut), replace the visual planning block: call const run = runVignette(sheet, lib, { phrases: sb.script.phrases }); Block (throw) if run.report.summary.blocking, if run.validation has unknown/invalid, if any staging issue severity==='error', if any camera source==='blocked_best_effort', or if run.coverage.blocking. Reject unknown/unresolved assets: assert every resolution item is 'available' (no 'placeholder') for characters/props/sets used in the production render, and that S7 planned VFX/text/SFX ids only appear when the local runtime has a real implementation (VFX_DEFS/TEXT_STYLE_DEFS/SFX_DEFS lookups already guard this — keep them). Confirm the teacher, door@1.1.0, classroom@1.2.0 resolved as available.

Keep the S7 caption/graphics/VFX/audio compilation as-is: phrasesFromBeats/planBoldCaptions/checkBoldPlan, textGraphicsFromBeats, vfxEventsFromBeats, mixPlanFromBeatSheet + mixVoiceSfx (targetLufs -14, truePeak -1). Assert mixed.report.music==='none', beat-sheet music entries are ignored (audioPlan.ignoredMusic reason music_added_in_editing), no unmixed cues, all approved SFX cues resolve (expect 19), and SFX sit >=6 dB below active voice. Do NOT add music/ambience.

Build the web bundle (tsc -p tsconfig.web.json) then launch Chromium and load /dist/.../preview/vignette-full-page.js instead of stills-page.js. Call window.__s7v.init(sheet, lib, run.shots, W, H). Compute caption placements via __s7v.place(captionPlan.captions, graphics); assert zero face conflicts (clearOfFaces && faceOverlapPx===0) across ALL segments — recomputed against every output frame and including the teacher's face. Write caption-placements.json.

Add a 30fps DENSE camera audit before encoding: sample the solved camera at every output frame (not just the sparse beat samples), and re-run camera-safety acceptance on each dense frame (reuse the vignette camera-safety evaluator / geometry). If a sparse ShotChoice fails dense validation at some frame, re-solve that beat's shot (tighten variant) or fall back to a camera-safety vetted safe fallback; never emit random shake or arbitrary cuts. Record dense-audit results (per-beat accepted frame fraction) in verification.json. Do NOT weaken existing camera-safety gates.

Run the teacher/door pixel-geometry gates via __s7v diagnostics and FAIL the render if any do not hold: teacher instantiated from teacher@1.0.0 (never placeholder); teacher meaningfully visible (projected area above a threshold, not just rig-present) during p01 exit samples ~2.4/3.0/3.8s AND p13 return samples ~60.3/60.8/61.5/62.5s AND remains visibly present across p14 ~65.5-68.5s; real door@1.1.0 built; door leaf/grip world transform visibly moves between a closed sample and an open sample (p01 close->open and p13 open); doorway+door appear on camera during >=1 p01 sample and >=1 p13 sample; no duplicate fallback doorway (scene used doorOpening, not doorFrame); teacher face participates in caption avoidance (already covered by place()).

Run the performance-motion gates via __s7v.jointSample and FAIL if the result is only head-turning: measure meaningful body/joint/root deltas at representative times per the beat plan — p02 look_around neck+torso; p03 celebrate arms rise + torso bounce + root squash/stretch; p04 dance alternating arms/legs + torso sway; p06 head_shake neck + Kira strict face + Zapp translation toward button; p07 press hand reaches the button contact anchor; p08 facepalm Kira hand approaches face + Zapp celebration; p10 stand_up Kira posture transition; p11 walk Kira root displacement to kira_safe; p12 Zapp prone/flattened + Kira recoil; p13 teacher root displacement through doorway; p14 teacher look target toward scene. Require action-specific FaceTrack expressions and deterministic blinks, and assert narrator VO does not drive character mouth openness. Record all measured deltas in verification.json.

Encode N frames deterministically via __s7v.initCapture + encodeRange (batched as in v1), assert samples.length===N and no pageerror. Encode AAC-LC (encodeAacLc), mux fast-start MP4 (muxMp4), probe via probeFile + checkProductionProfile with the review spec: 540x960, 30fps, H.264 High/yuv420p, AAC-LC 48kHz stereo, fast-start, duration range [69,69.2] covering the full ~69.167s VO. Write probe.json.

Verify independent playback (verifyPlayback at representative seek times incl. teacher/door/impact moments), AAC round-trip (aacRoundTrip SNR>=15dB/channel), and container alignment (mp4AudioAlignment lag<=48 samples, decoded within 1024 samples of mixed length). A/V duration drift <= one frame. Assert droppedFrames===0 and no playback errors.

Also assert the EDITING/CAMERA redesign targets over the solved shots for the 69s VO: ~35-45 meaningful compositions/cuts, median composition ~1.2-1.8s, no repeated identical Zapp/Kira classroom singles, camera translation in ~35-55% of frames, visible zoom/lens activity in ~30-50% of frames. If the current recipe assignment does not reach these ranges, adjust the per-beat camera recipe choices in the beat sheet's camera fields OR add intra-beat sub-shot cut points the adapter/pipeline honors (still one caption band per shot; captions stable within a shot). Keep semantic cut patterns (establishing wide, reaction close-up, OTS, prop insert, action-contact close-up, low-angle reveal, two-shot contrast, consequence wide, reaction-then-insert, payoff) and intra-shot moves (slow push-in, small dolly/arc, anticipation before press, punch-in at contact, scale reveal during coin growth, shake only at impact, reframing during walk/door transit, settle after impact). Record the composition/translation/zoom metrics in verification.json. Camera variations may change only at hard caption/semantic boundaries.

Write packages/captions/full-render-v2/ output: zapp-vs-kira-competitor-performance-v2.mp4; verification.json (schema, inputs incl. voice sha + storyboard sha + beat sheet, output file+sha256+bytes+dims+fps+frames+duration+codec+faststart, s7 caption/vfx/sfx counts + music none + faceConflicts 0, dense-camera audit, teacher/door evidence, performance-motion deltas, composition/translation/zoom metrics, audio report, all media-verification results, frame hashes, MP4 SHA-256); and the 7 named frame PNGs (frame-teacher-exit.png ~3.0s, frame-zapp-celebrate.png ~11s, frame-button-press.png ~32.2s, frame-coin-growth.png ~45s, frame-impact.png ~57s, frame-teacher-return.png ~61s, frame-final-payoff.png ~67s) captured via the adapter's frame path. Leave comparison-sheet.jpg to FEAT-004 (it needs decoded v2 + competitors + v1).
Confirm v1 is byte-identical: recompute SHA-256 of packages/captions/full-render/zapp-vs-kira-full-s7.mp4 and confirm it still equals 6317404e146e8b7fd9bef5e56760bdfa0f99c51e9de8da61ffb6ead1fa6afe28.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it passes with the render-full.ts changes.
acceptance_criteria: render-full.ts has a vignette visual mode (default for v2) that uses runVignette + the vignette-full-page adapter and blocks on validation/staging/camera/coverage failure and on any unknown/unresolved asset or non-S7 placeholder.
packages/captions/full-render-v2/ contains zapp-vs-kira-competitor-performance-v2.mp4, verification.json, and the 7 named frame PNGs.
The v2 MP4 is 540x960, 30fps, H.264 High/yuv420p, AAC-LC 48kHz stereo, fast-start, ~69.167s, VO+event-SFX only, music none, 19 SFX cues resolved, SFX >=6dB under voice.

All gates pass and are recorded in verification.json: runVignette PASS, no staging errors, no unknown assets, no non-S7 placeholders, 30fps dense camera acceptance, teacher exit(p01)+return(p13)+present(p14) meaningful visibility, real door built + hinge leaf/grip movement + doorway on camera in p01 and p13, no duplicate fallback doorway, performance-motion deltas prove full-body actions (not head-turns), FaceTrack expressions+blinks with no VO mouth-flap, all captions clear of all faces (0 conflicts), all required VFX/SFX visible/resolved, production profile PASS, Chromium seek/playback PASS with 0 dropped frames/errors, AAC round-trip SNR>=15dB/channel, MP4 audio lag<=48 samples, decoded length error<=1024 samples, A/V drift <=1 frame.
Camera redesign metrics fall in target ranges (~35-45 compositions, median ~1.2-1.8s, translation ~35-55%, zoom ~30-50%) and are recorded in verification.json.
The approved voice bytes/timing are unchanged (no cut/stretch/speedup); voice sha still matches storyboard.audio.contentHash.
verification: Run the extended render-full.ts in vignette mode end-to-end (with --voice .scratch/voice/eleven-1.mp3 --ffmpeg <ffmpeg-static> and FFPROBE_PATH set) and confirm it completes with all gates passing and writes the full-render-v2 output set.
Read packages/captions/full-render-v2/verification.json and confirm every gate field is pass/true and the metrics are in range.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm pass.
Recompute SHA-256 of the v1 mp4 and confirm it is unchanged; run `node packages/captions/tools/verify-mvp.ts` and confirm the v1 full-render hash checks still pass (v1 untouched).
Confirm the v2 mp4 exists, is fast-start H.264+AAC 540x960 30fps ~69.167s via ffprobe, and its SHA-256 is recorded in verification.json.

findings.summary: Wired the vignette visual mode (default) into render-full.ts and ran the full 2075-frame v2 render end-to-end with every acceptance gate passing. Output written to packages/captions/full-render-v2/. v1 golden untouched.

v2_mp4.profile: 540x960, 30fps, H.264 High/yuv420p, AAC-LC 48kHz stereo, fast-start, duration 69.167s

findings.png_bug_fix: Prior run wrote the 7 evidence frames as .png files that actually held JPEG bytes (adapter frame() returns image/jpeg). Added a lossless framePng() method (out.toDataURL('image/png')) to packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.ts and switched render-full.ts to call it, plus a PNG-magic-byte assertion so a .png can never silently hold JPEG again. Verified via `file`: all 7 are now PNG image data 540x960 RGBA.

gates.runVignette: PASS - 14 beats, 41 compositions, coverage 96.6%, 14 recipe / 0 fallback / 0 blocked cameras; teacher=teacher@1.0.0, door=door@1.1.0, classroom=classroom@1.2.0 all built (source 'builder', not placeholder).
gates.denseCameraAudit: allFramesAccepted=true across all 2075 output frames (per-beat accepted-frame fractions recorded).
gates.teacher: sourceKey teacher@1.0.0; exitOk (p01 ~2.4/3.0/3.8s), returnOk (p13 ~60.3/60.8/61.5/62.5s), presentOk (p14 ~65.5-68.5s, >=2 meaningful). areaFrac threshold 0.006.
gates.door: sourceKey door@1.1.0; usedRealDoorway=true (doorOpening node, no fallback doorFrame); leaf/grip moved closed->p01-open; doorway on camera in p01 and p13.
gates.performanceMotion: 14 checks all pass proving full-body motion (root/limb/torso deltas above thresholds, not head-turns); FaceTrack expressions present; blinksDeterministic=true; mouthNarrationDriven=false (VO never flaps character mouths).
gates.captionFaceSafety: 61 captions / 87 placement segments / 0 face conflicts against all projected faces incl. teacher.
gates.audio: music none; 4 beat-sheet music entries ignored as music_added_in_editing; 19 SFX cues all resolved/mixed; SFX >=6dB under active voice; targetLufs -14, truePeak -1. Approved VO padded to N frames, never cut (voiceSha d97fd865... == storyboard.audio.contentHash).
gates.media: productionProfile ok; droppedFrames 0; AAC round-trip SNR [27.77, 27.80] dB (>=15); mp4AudioAlignment lag 0 samples; decoded within 1024 samples; A/V drift 0.00033s (<= 1 frame).
gates.cameraMetrics: compositions 41 (35-45), medianCompositionSec 1.6 (1.2-1.8), repeatedIdenticalZappKiraSingles 0, translationFrac 0.456 (0.35-0.55), zoomFrac 0.324 (0.30-0.50) - all in range.

Supported by new subShots schema+validation in packages/director/src/beat-sheet.ts and composition solving in packages/vignette/src/pipeline.ts (runVignette now returns compositions[]). Re-ran verify-mvp.ts (gates 47/47, faceConflicts 0, music none, sfx 19) and narrated-integration-analysis.ts (47/47, exit 0) - both still pass.
